text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Lalu Lintas

Jalan (Larangan Pemanduan Kenderaan Barangan) (No. 2) 2026.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 19 Mac 2026.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan mana-mana jenis kenderaan barangan yang dinyatakan dalam

ruang (1) Jadual di atas mana-mana bahagian mana-mana jalan adalah dilarang

pada 19, 20, 28 dan 29 Mac 2026 pada masa yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2).

(2) Walau apa pun larangan dalam subkaedah (1), Menteri boleh

mengecualikan mana-mana jenis kenderaan barangan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual daripada larangan itu tertakluk kepada apa-apa syarat yang ditentukan olehnya.

JADUAL

[Kaedah 2]

(1)

Jenis kenderaan barangan

(2)

(a) Lori pembawa dan lori jongket yang berat

dengan muatannya melebihi 7,500 kg,

lori pengangkut rendah, treler tiang, treler

sepanjang masa

(2)

pelantar, lori balak, jentera berat beroda,

trak tunda dan traktor (kecuali jentera

berat beroda, trak tunda dan traktor yang

digunakan bagi maksud operasi

kecemasan dan menyelamat)

(b) Lori yang berat dengan muatannya

melebihi 7,500 kg yang mengangkut simen,

besi, keluli, batu, pasir, tanah, amang,

bijih timah, arang batu atau bahan binaan

atau bahan galian yang lain

sepanjang masa

(c) Lori kontena yang mengangkut barangan

(kecuali lori kontena yang mengangkut

barangan dari pelabuhan atau lapangan

terbang ke kawasan perindustrian

di dalam negeri yang sama dan sebaliknya)

dari 8.00 malam hingga 8.00 pagi

(d) Lori kargo yang mengangkut barangan

elektronik atau elektrik atau

bahan industri kimia dari pelabuhan

atau lapangan terbang ke kawasan

perindustrian di dalam negeri yang sama

dan sebaliknya

dari 8.00 malam hingga 8.00 pagi

(e) Lori yang mengangkut tandan buah kelapa

sawit segar, produk kelapa sawit mentah,

getah sekerap dan susu getah

dari 8.00 malam hingga 8.00 pagi

(f) Lori kargo tanpa muatan dari 8.00 malam hingga 8.00 pagi

(1)

Jenis kenderaan barangan

(2)

Masa larangan

(g) Kren bergerak dan lori pembancuh simen dari 6.00 petang hingga 6.00 pagi

dalam jarak 25 km dari tapak

pembinaan tertakluk kepada

had masa operasi yang dibenarkan

di atas jalan tertentu

Dibuat12 Mac 2026

 LOKE SIEW FOOK

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRAFFIC (PROHIBITION ON DRIVING OF GOODS VEHICLES) (NO. 2) RULES 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 88(1)(c) and

subsection 88(4) of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister, after

consultation with the Minister charged with the responsibility for works, makes the

following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Road Traffic (Prohibition on

Driving of Goods Vehicles) (No. 2) Rules 2026.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 19 March 2026.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of any type of goods vehicles specified in column (1)

of the Schedule on any part of any road is prohibited on 19, 20, 28 and 29 March 2026

at the time specified in column (2).

(2) Notwithstanding the prohibition in subrule (1), the Minister may exempt

any type of goods vehicles specified in column (1) of the Schedule from the prohibiton

subject to such conditions as he may determine.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

(1)

Type of goods vehicle

(2)

Time of prohibition

(a) Carrier lorry and tipper lorry of which

its laden weight exceeds 7,500 kg,

low loader lorry, pole trailer,

platform trailer, timber lorry, wheeled

at all times

(1)

Type of goods vehicle

(2)

Time of prohibition

heavy machinery, tow truck and tractor

(except wheeled heavy machinery,

tow truck and tractor used for the purpose

of emergency and rescue operations)

(b) Lorry of which its laden weight exceeds

7,500 kg transporting cement, iron, steel,

stones, sand, earth, tailing, tin, coal or other

construction materials or mineral

materials

at all times

(c) Container lorry transporting goods (except

container lorry transporting goods from

a port or an airport to an industrial area

in the same state and vice versa)

from 8.00 p.m. to 8.00 a.m.

(d) Cargo lorry transporting electronic or

electrical goods or chemical industry

material from a port or an airport to

an industrial area in the same state and

vice versa

from 8.00 p.m. to 8.00 a.m.

(e) Lorry transporting fresh palm oil fruit

bunch, raw palm oil products, scrap rubber

and latex

from 8.00 p.m. to 8.00 a.m.

(f) Cargo lorry without a load from 8.00 p.m. to 8.00 a.m.

(1)

(2)

(g) Mobile crane and cement mixer lorry from 6.00 p.m. to 6.00 a.m.

within 25 km from the

construction site subject to the

allowed on certain roads

Made 12 March 2026
